# Introduction

StreamFind is a project-based analytical workflow framework built around
persistent DuckDB-backed `Project` classes. The package currently focuses on
mass spectrometry workflows, including raw-data exploration, spectra and
chromatogram inspection, and non-target analysis with native workflow methods.

The same project state can be used from R scripts or through the embedded Shiny
application. Workflows are defined as ordered `Workflow` objects composed of
validated project-owned `Method` metadata objects, then executed into the
project database for later inspection and reporting.

See the [articles](https://odea-project.github.io/StreamFind/articles/index.html)
for guided examples and developer notes.
